title: File:Hardrock 100 Winner (7568069014).jpg (2026-11-07 check: host unreachable from this network; not re-verified)
claims: The file shows the first runners through a point where the Ice Lake trail briefly merges with the Hardrock 100 course in 2012.
The file description notes that the race started at 6 am in Silverton, Colorado, and the photo was taken on the Ice Lake trail.
The uploader and author is John Fowler from Placitas, NM, credited under CC BY 2.0.
